unit_of_analysis: all 7906 QA records from 150 independently executed samples

latency.retrieval_latency_p50_ms: Hyndman-Fan type-7 50th percentile of per-QA eval.retrieval_seconds times 1000
latency.retrieval_latency_p95_ms: Hyndman-Fan type-7 95th percentile of per-QA eval.retrieval_seconds times 1000
latency.end_to_end_latency_p50_ms: Hyndman-Fan type-7 50th percentile of per-QA retrieval_seconds plus answer_seconds, times 1000
latency.end_to_end_latency_p95_ms: Hyndman-Fan type-7 95th percentile of per-QA retrieval_seconds plus answer_seconds, times 1000
latency.exclusion: post-hoc evaluator and judge latency is excluded from user-facing latency but its tokens remain reported

resources.memory_storage_bytes: sum of regular-file sizes under every accepted unit baseline-storage directory
resources.peak_driver_ram_gib: maximum GNU time Maximum resident set size across accepted unit drivers, divided by 1024^2
resources.peak_vram_gib: maximum concurrent sum of nvidia-smi memory.used over allocated GPUs 1, 3, 4, and 5, divided by 1024
resources.gpu_hours: elapsed seconds between first and last complete five-second GPU monitor samples, times four allocated GPUs, divided by 3600

comparability_rules: All locally reproduced methods use the same server, model services, GPU assignment, monitor interval, sample inventory, and sequential execution policy.
A resource or latency cell remains NA if its raw evidence is missing or incomplete; it is never imputed from another run or an official paper.
The four allocated GPUs include answer and two embedding services, even when a method does not use every embedding endpoint.
GPU-hours are allocated service-window hours, not utilization-weighted compute hours.
